title: The Sun Stands Still over Gibeon
description: Five Amorite kings attacked Gibeon because the city had made peace with Israel. Joshua marched out from Gilgal, and the Lord threw the enemy into confusion and sent hailstones from heaven. Joshua prayed that the sun and moon would stand still, and the sun remained in the middle of the sky until Israel had won the victory.

versions.title: The Sun Stands Still
versions.description: Joshua asked God to make the sun and moon stand still while Israel fought against the Amorites, and God answered his prayer and gave Israel victory.
